hero.title: What are showcases?
hero.text: Datasets have been used to build apps, websites and visualizations. They've been featured in articles, and written about in news reports and blog posts. Showcases collect together the best examples of datasets in use, to provide further insight, ideas, and inspiration.

submit_prompt.title: Your showcase here?
submit_prompt.abstract: Submit your own showcase to share your project with the community, advertise your datasets and inspire others.

paragraph.top: We are pleased that you would like to share your Open Data project. Please fill out the form to create a showcase. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. We will then review your request and contact you as soon as possible.
paragraph.more:
To optimize communication about your showcase and boost its visibility on the portal and social media, we invite you to answer a few additional questions. Your answers will help us draft the descriptive text (red box shown here).

All questions are optional: just answer the ones you find most relevant – we’ll take care of the rest!

who_are_you.label: Who are you?
who_are_you.organization: Name of your organization or team
who_are_you.mission: {mainObjective} (For example: improving transportation, raising climate awareness, etc.)
who_are_you.mainObjective: What is your mission or main objective?

goal.label: What is the goal of your showcase in one sentence?
goal.hint: What question does your showcase answer? What need or problem does it address?
goal.help: To help you, you can phrase your answer like this: “Thanks to this showcase, the user can…”

why.label: Why did you use this specific data?
why.hint:
Why is this data useful for this showcase? (Example: it meets a specific need, it is accessible, it is rich in
up-to-date information)
why.what: What technologies or tools do you use to leverage this data?
why.challenges: Are there any limitations or challenges in using this data?

users.label: Who are the end users?
users.how: {usefulness} (Example: simplifying a service, solving a problem.)
users.usefulness: How is this showcase useful to them?
users.benefits: {whichFields} (Can you provide concrete examples of its application? Is your showcase already being used in these fields?)
users.whichFields: Which fields benefit from the reuse of this data?

challengesBefore.label: What challenges did end users face BEFORE using your showcase?
challengesBefore.hint: {majorChallenges} (Example: access to data, lack of resources, technical complexity.)

challengesCreating.label: What challenges did YOU face in creating this showcase?
challengesCreating.preparing: Did you have to prepare or clean the data before using it?
challengesCreating.finding: Was it easy to find the data?
challengesCreating.identifying: How did you identify relevant data sources?
challengesCreating.accessing: Did you encounter any difficulties accessing the data? (Example: licensing restrictions, data quality)

getMost.label: What should the user do to get the most out of this showcase?
getMost.conditions: Are there any specific conditions that must be met (free access, registration, usage restrictions)?
getMost.tips: Do you have any tips or advice for getting the most out of it?

anythingElse.label: Would you like to add anything else?
anythingElse.mentionHint: Do you have any {hashtags} to share or {people} to mention? (Please provide links to the relevant social media accounts or website)
anythingElse.visualsHint: Do you have any {visuals} or additional materials to share?

block_1.title: About us
block_1.paragraph_1: The opendata.swiss portal is a joint project of the Confederation, cantons, communes and other organizations with a mandate from the state. It makes open government data available to the general public in a central catalogue. opendata.swiss is operated by the Federal Statistical Office.
